title: Pudhu Pettai
desc: A young boy runs away when his mother dies and ends up in the company of a gangster. He soon becomes the right-hand man of his employer and makes dangerous enemies.

title: Kuppathu Raja
desc: Selvam, a taxi driver, is on a mission to seek revenge on a person. Little does he know that Raja, with whom he has a budding friendship, is the person he dislikes.

title: Pattukku Oru Thalaivan
desc: Devastated by Shanthi's rejection, Arivu turns to alcoholism to drown his despair. However, beneath her silence lies a hidden truth that could shatter their past and redefine their futures.

title: Neethaane En Ponvasantham
desc: Varun and Nithya's childhood romance is cut short when they pursue different paths in life. Years later, fate reunites them and Varun sets out on a heartfelt journey to win back the love of his life.

title: Rendu
desc: Sakthi moves to the city in search of a job. However, he lands in trouble when a CBI officer mistakes him for a serial killer who is his doppelgänger.
